_note: Initial values only. Once seeded, the DATABASE is the source of truth and Josue edits these in the admin. Every default is sourced - most from promises his own website already makes. See planning/01-SETTINGS.md.

business.brand_region.why: researched 2026-09-10. Headline copy only, never a boundary claim - Malibu/Agoura/Westlake are LA County

service_area.booking_mode.why: 16 city pages exist and no others

service_area.outside_area_behaviour.why: never turn away a lead; let Josue decide

pricing.tax_mode.why: no tax appears anywhere on the site

pricing.quote_required_message.v: We'll confirm your price after a quick look at your yard.

billing.deposit_mode.why: 'No sign-up fees.' His words. The capability exists; the default is off

billing.charge_timing.why: matches how a scooping round works

billing.invoice_cadence.why: a weekly $15 charge is 4 Stripe fees a month; monthly is cheaper for him

billing.card_on_file_required.why: weekly service. One-time jobs over $99 ask for one

billing.card_required_above_cents.why: protects him on big jobs without touching the weekly promise

billing.offline_methods.why: how he is paid today. Stripe is ADDED, not substituted

billing.connect_account_type.why: forced by the requirement that he can bring an existing Stripe account

schedule.service_days.why: Ben, 2026-09-10: any day of the week

schedule.same_day_every_week.why: 'Same day every week.' His core promise and a real routing constraint

schedule.driver_consistency.why: his reviews praise exactly this. 'required' once there is enough crew

schedule.visit_window_hours.why: an arrival window, not a time. Nothing on the site promises a time

schedule.new_customer_start_days.why: 'start within a few days, depending on route availability'

visit.require_completion_photo.why: his differentiator is proof of care, and it costs the crew four seconds

visit.skip_notice_hours.why: 'Just let us know in advance' - no number given, so none invented

visit.failed_access_policy.why: he drove there, but nothing on his site warns customers. Notify him; let him set a policy

visit.gate_code_visible_to.why: the most sensitive value in this database

subscription.pause_max_weeks.why: no published limit; a cap that stops a paused row living forever

subscription.auto_resume_after_pause.why: pausing for vacation should not silently end service

notify.from_address.why: current; authenticates independently of his own SPF

notify.on_the_way_enabled.why: the Uber comparison lives or dies on this
